newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 16.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wedesday's Daily Variety:

* General Electric's NBC maintained its position at the top of the Nielsen ratings in the April 7-13 week, despite a late rally by Westinghouse CBS. Walt Disney's ABC had the worst week in-season rating in the history of the big three networks.
* Lachlan Murdoch, 25, would assume responsibility for News Corp's Australian unit News Ltd after the retirement of Ken Cowley at the end of June.
* Former "Beverly Hills, 90210" star Shannen Doherty is looking to return to primetime television in a comedy Witt-Thomas Productions is developing for Fox Broadcasting Co.
* Around 40 percent of films in the market will have a world premier at the 50th Cannes Film Festival, far more than usual. Events include a by French President Jacques Chirac.
* Bill Paxton, David Paymer, Regina King and Naveen Andrews have all been cast in "Mighty Joe Young" for Walt Disney Pictures, sources said.
* Film producer Arnold Kopelson paid mid-six figures for a preemptive option for "Most Wanted," an action-thriller book by John Gilstrap.
* Two major entertainment companies were still waiting to hear from James Cameron on whether his "Titanic" film will be released on the scheduled date of July 2.
